sdk_fortran.evidence: Current maintained GIMP GNOME 50 recipe builds OpenBLAS/LAPACK without an extra Fortran SDK extension. This is recipe evidence, not an executed gfortran probe.

unresolved.detail: The source-native-codecs.json graph supplies all previously missing native libraries and retains the upstream Linux wheel extension set. Source archives/commits and Rust dependencies are pinned. An actual GNOME 50 build must still verify compatibility; source-codec-check.py fails if any required extension cannot import. No native source-build or runtime parity result is claimed.

Run the source graph in the GNOME 50 SDK with gfortran and Rust extension; verify Python build backend bounds, every native codec, source-built engine parity, TIFF/ICC precision, source runtime smoke and the installed native window. No native source-build execution has been performed.

deliberate_recipe_choices: Build LLVM 22.1.8 from source for llvmlite 0.49.0; do not copy LLVM runtime libraries from an SDK extension.
Build OpenCV with an isolated source-built NumPy 2.1.3 and setuptools 69.5.1 build environment, retaining NumPy 2.5.3 at runtime.
Use isolated source-built setuptools-scm 7.1.0 for python-dateutil; retain SCM 9.2.2 for current build backends.
Disable OpenCV IPP/ITT/G-API implicit downloads; validate full application behavior before acceptance.
Disable OIIO OpenColorIO and command-line tools; LightTable uses its own ICC path. This source-build feature difference requires native regression validation.
Build all four imagecodecs AVIF backends (AOM, dav1d, rav1e and SVT-AV1) from pinned source; no external downloads inside compilation.
Apply the upstream libpng 1.6.58 APNG patch; use libjpeg-turbo 3 for the imagecodecs JPEG8 API.
Keep lzham compatibility headers isolated so its bundled zlib.h cannot replace the SDK zlib header.
Disable libultrahdr HEIF integration: imagecodecs uses the JPEG gain-map API and omits the HEIF extension in its Linux wheel set. This feature choice remains subject to native parity validation.
